name: Castlevania: Moonlight Rhapsody
summary: Castlevania: Moonlight Rhapsody was a mobile game that was part of the Castlevania franchise, developed and published by Shengqu Games under license of Konami Digital Entertainment for the Chinese market. Originally appearing in 2019 to be a Castlevania-esque original title, it was announced as a Konami-licensed game in 2020, starring a mix of canon Castlevania characters and original characters. Despite at least one test launch in 2021, the game is presumed to be cancelled.
